signal: VertexOne launched VXconnect, a new customer engagement engine for energy and utility providers

email.body1:
Mike, saw VertexOne launched VXconnect to modernize customer engagement for energy and utility providers.

A new platform launch usually means more in-market accounts than the regional team can cover before the message lands everywhere it should. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VertexOne off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for VertexOne.

Pushing a new product into the utility market usually raises the meeting target faster than a regional team can staff for. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit quota until the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for VertexOne.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority for the region right now, no problem at all. Rolling out a new platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional utility sales motion? I'll tailor it to VertexOne either way.
